description: Source code for memory page management in jemalloc, including functions for mapping, unmapping, committing, decommitting, and setting huge page states, with system-specific handling and lazy purge support.

methods.name: os_pages_map
methods.description: Maps memory pages with system-specific handling, supporting alignment and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: os_pages_trim
methods.description: Trims over-allocated memory to the desired size, unmapping excess regions.

methods.name: os_pages_unmap
methods.description: Unmaps memory pages, handling system-specific calls and error reporting.

methods.name: pages_map_slow
methods.description: Creates an aligned memory mapping by over-allocating and trimming.

methods.name: pages_map
methods.description: Creates a memory mapping with optional fixed address and alignment, with system-specific optimizations.

methods.name: pages_unmap
methods.description: Unmaps memory pages at a given address and size.

methods.name: pages_commit_impl
methods.description: Handles committing or decommitting memory pages, system-specific.

methods.name: pages_commit
methods.description: Commits memory pages.

methods.name: pages_decommit
methods.description: Decommits memory pages.

methods.name: pages_purge_lazy
methods.description: Performs lazy purge of memory pages, system-specific.

methods.name: pages_purge_forced
methods.description: Forcibly purges memory pages, system-specific.

methods.name: pages_huge_impl
methods.description: Sets huge page advice with madvise, supports aligned and unaligned pages.

methods.name: pages_huge
methods.description: Marks pages as huge pages.

methods.name: pages_huge_unaligned
methods.description: Marks unaligned pages as huge pages.

methods.name: pages_nohuge_impl
methods.description: Marks pages as not huge with madvise.

methods.name: pages_nohuge
methods.description: Marks pages as not huge.

methods.name: pages_nohuge_unaligned
methods.description: Marks unaligned pages as not huge.

methods.name: pages_dontdump
methods.description: Marks pages to be excluded from core dumps.

methods.name: pages_dodump
methods.description: Marks pages to be included in core dumps.

methods.name: os_page_detect
methods.description: Detects system page size.

methods.name: os_overcommits_sysctl
methods.description: Checks overcommit setting via sysctl.

methods.name: os_overcommits_proc
methods.description: Checks overcommit setting via /proc/sys.

methods.name: pages_set_thp_state
methods.description: Sets transparent huge page state for a memory region.

methods.name: init_thp_state
methods.description: Initializes transparent huge page configuration based on system settings.

methods.name: pages_boot
methods.description: Performs system-specific initialization for page management.
